Website Policy

HYPERLINKING POLICY

Links to external websites/portals

We don't mind linking directly to the information hosted on your site and no prior permission is required for this. However, we ask that you notify us of any links provided on our site so that you can be informed of any changes or updates therein. Also, we do not allow our pages to be loaded into frames on your site. The pages of our website should load in the user's newly opened browser window.

COPYRIGHT POLICY

The material displayed on this portal may be reproduced free of charge after taking proper permission by sending a mail to us. However, the material must be reproduced accurately and must not be used in a derogatory manner or in a misleading context. Wherever the material is being published or released to others, the source should be prominently acknowledged.

Although,Permission to reproduce this material shall not extend to any material that is identified to be the copyright of a third party. Authorization to reproduce such material should be obtained from the concerned departments/copyright holders.

These Terms and Conditions shall be governed by and applicable in accordance with the Indian laws. Any dispute arising under these terms and conditions shall be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts in India.

PRIVACY POLICY

The ORGI website does not automatically collect any specific personal information (such as name, phone number or e-mail address) from you that allows us to identify you personally.

If the ORGI website requests you to provide personal information, you will be notified of the specific purposes for which the information is collected and adequate security measures will be taken to protect your personal information.

We do not voluntarily sell or share any personally identifiable information on the ORGI website to any third party (public/private). Any information provided to this website will be protected from loss, misuse, unauthorized access or disclosure, alteration, or destruction.

We collect certain information about the user, such as Internet Protocol (IP) addresses, domain name, browser type, operating system, date and time of visit and pages visited. We make no effort to link these addresses to the identities of individuals who visit our sites unless there is an attempt to damage the site.

Product & Services

Vital Statistics including Registration of Births and Deaths has been incorporated at Sl. No. 30 under Concurrent List of the Constitution of India. Registration of Births and Deaths in India is mandatory with the enactment of Registration of Births and Death Act (RBD Act), 1969 (amended in 2023) and is done as per place of occurrence of the event.

Birth and Death are the two important vital events in the life-cycle of an individual. Not only do they describe the legal existence of an individual, registration of these events is the main source of basic vital statistics.

To facilitate the general public and registration functionaries, the ORGI has developed a central CRS portal for online registration of births and deaths. Through this portal, along with registration of births and deaths, vital statistics on the basis of registered events would also be generated.

The services that can be availed by general public through the portal are as under:

  • Online reporting of Births and Deaths including delayed events.
  • Online payment of fee towards different services like duplicate certificate, delayed reporting of events, delayed insertion of names etc.
  • Tracking of status of submitted applications.
  • Correction/cancellation of records.
  • Digitization of old records/certificates.
  • SRS App Name- SRS-Verbal Autopsy (Google play store)

Pricing

Fees payable:

  1. No fees is required to be paid if the event is reported within 21 days of its occurrence.
  2. The fees payable for a search to be made, an extract or a non-availability certificate to be issued under Section 17 and delayed registration of events under Section 13 are varies from State to State in accordance with the State Rules. However, only for indicative purpose, the fees to be payable as per the Model Registration of Births and Deaths (Amendment) Rules, 2024, are as follows:
Sl. No.ServiceService Charges (in Rs.)
(a)Search for a single entry in the first year for which the search is made20.00
(b)for every additional year for which the search is continued20.00
(c)For granting extract relating to each birth or death50.00
(d)for granting non-availability certificate of birth or death20.00
(e)insertion of name of child after 15 years of registration5.00
Delayed Registration of events
(f)after 21 days but within 30 days of occurrence20.00
(g)after 30 days but within one year of occurrence50.00
(h)after one year of occurrence100.00

Cancellation & Refund Policy

When you make a payment towards services of birth/death registration, you agree to use a valid payment method. You agree to pay the fee / penalty for the services related to birth and death registration that you request from respective Registrar of Births and Deaths, and you authorize us to charge your debit or credit card or process other available means of payment for those fee. The ORGI works with third-party payment processing partners to offer you the most convenient payment methods and to keep your payment information secure. Check out our Privacy Policy for more details.

The informants / parents are therefore requested to review the details of the child at the time of birth reporting and of deceased at the time of death reporting so that the birth / death certificate(s) could be issued error free after registration of the event. The amount of fee/fine once paid, is not refundable/transferrable under any circumstances (except to the applicant who might have ended up in paying fee more than once due to any technical issue with the server of the bank/ payment gateway concerned. However, such refund would be made only after ascertaining the actual receipt of payment of prescribed service more than once, which would be possible only after reconciliation of collected fee data as received from the banks concerned with the fee data recorded in the server) even in case of cancellation / rejection of an application by the respective registering authority.

Grievance Management Policy

Section 25A of the Registration of Births and Deaths Act, 1969 (amended in 2023) provides for grievance redressal mechanism

  1. Any person aggrieved by any action or order of:
    1. the Registrar, may prefer an appeal to the District Registrar; or
    2. the District Registrar, may prefer an appeal to the Chief Registrar, within a period of thirty days from the date of such action or receipt of such order, as the case may be, in such form and manner as may be prescribed.
  2. The District Registrar or the Chief Registrar, as the case may be, shall decide the appeal referred to in sub-section (1) within a period of ninety days from the date of preferring of such appeal.
